Two TypeScript surfaces exist, for different jobs: You want to Use Add a page, block or layout to the UI that aiui run serves @aiui/sdk, provided by the React app shell at runtime. Nothing to install; see UI plugins Render an aiui build site inside your own React or Next.js app The optional praisonaiui package in src/praisonaiui-ts; see TypeScript SDK The UI that ships with the Python package (src/frontend) is private and not published to npm.
